subathon.booked_closed: Noted – nothing was credited, it is not running right now.
subathon.happy_hint: An hour in which donations are worth more. Subs and bits are not affected – same as in the program.
subathon.lead: A stream that grows: subs, bits and donations push the end back – up to the cap.
subathon.locked: The subathon is running – start, cap and the values per sub cannot be changed now. Pausing does not help: the numbers hold for the whole run.
subathon.log_confirm: The whole history is deleted. This cannot be undone.
subathon.manual_hint: For what does not arrive by itself: a donation through another route, a sub from chat, or simply time. The amount means something different per button – «Donation» is cents, «Bits» is bits, «Gift subs» is the count.
subathon.messages_hint: One message per line, they rotate in the overlay every ten seconds. An empty line is a pause. The placeholders below are filled in when shown.
subathon.name: Subathon
subathon.overlay_hint: The colours of the three sections in the overlay. A name like «skyblue» or a value like «#f79191».
subathon.perm.edit: Configure, pause and reset the subathon
subathon.prices_hint: In euro. Only the ratio matters: a tier 1 sub is worth the configured minutes, the others according to their price. Doubling all three changes nothing.
subathon.reset_confirm: Resetting puts duration, pause and start back to the beginning. The history stays.
subathon.settings_hint: Start and cap decide when it begins and how long it can last. The three values below decide what a sub, a bit and a cent are worth – the seconds next to them follow from that.
subathon.settings_lead: About the plugin itself. How the subathon runs – start, cap, what a sub is worth – is on its own page.
subathon.show_manual_hint: Subs, bits and donations book themselves. By hand is only needed when something arrives on a route this system cannot see – a bank transfer, a gift in chat.
